tool_args.rationale: The field, sink-gradient, and lag signatures favor the coupled ODE, but the pilot endpoints span only H = 0.38–0.52. The trajectory batch adds time-resolved observations to distinguish relaxation from coupling before fitting and testing against the 0.045 RMSE tolerance.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter siphon-memory ODE now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five endpoint observations for five parameters leave no residual degrees of freedom and limited leverage to separate memory relaxation from coupling strength.
Neither model represents the observed transient lag or dependence on the initial state and memory.
It does not measure the transient needed to distinguish the candidate mechanisms.
